name: print_look_description
purpose: Prints the LOOK2.DAT description of terrain tile `tile`: reads the u16 at file offset tile*2 (the offset table has 0x200 entries), then 0x80 bytes of text at that offset into a stack buffer and print_string()s it (NUL-terminated inside the file). No line ending is appended.
notes: Ghidra mislabelled it NPC_a290 (shared load address).

name: look_well
proto: void look_well(byte x, byte y, byte z)  /* Ghidra: (z=param_1, y=param_2, x=param_3) */
purpose: The wishing well (tile 0xa1). Prints 'a well.\n\nDrop a coin?' and loops read_command_key until Y or N. N prints 'No'. Y prints 'Yes'; with no gold returns silently; otherwise prints 'Thy wish?', spends one gold and reads up to 12 characters. Empty wish: 'Nothing'. If the wish contains Corvette/Ferrari/Lamborghini/Lotus/Porsche/Horse (str_find_ci) and the location is Paws (0x16) or Empath Abbey (0x1f): 'Poof!', play_random_tones(2000,3000,10) and set_monster_slot(find_spawn_slot(), value1 0, z, y, x+1, 0x10, 0x10) spawns a horse east of the party; otherwise 'No effect...' (two identical strings 0x7274/0x728c).
notes: Called by look_terrain with (g_party_z, g_party_y, g_party_x).

name: look_fountain
purpose: A fountain (tiles 0xd8-0xdb): prints 'a gurgling fountain!' and 'Who will drink?', select_party_member_no_zero(); -1 -> 'None!', member status 'D' or 'S' -> 'Incapacitated!', else 'Refreshing...'. Purely cosmetic.

name: draw_sky_planet
proto: void draw_sky_planet(int col, int row)  /* Ghidra: (row=param_1, col=param_2) */
purpose: Draws one planet of the telescope night sky in g_ui_color1 at view cell (row, col) in 8x8 cell units: pixel (row*8+8, col*8+6), a 3x3 block at (row*8+7+dy, col*8+7+dx) for pixels with x < 0xb1, and (row*8+8, col*8+10) when col*8 < 0xae. The clipping keeps the blob inside the 176-pixel view.

name: draw_sky_crescent
proto: void draw_sky_crescent(int col, int row)  /* Ghidra: (row, col) */
purpose: Draws the Shadowlord marker (an arc) in g_ui_color0 just right of a planet at view cell (row, col): vertical lines at x = col*8+5..+12 with y ranges row*8+10..12, 10..12, 8..12, 8..12, 6..10, 6..10, 5..8, 5..7; the first three need col*8 > 2 and the rest need col*8 < 0xb0/0xaf/0xae/0xad/0xac respectively (right-edge clipping).
notes: set_color is passed a junk second argument (param_1) by the compiler.

name: look_telescope
purpose: Vector 1778:079a (also called from CAST d712). Looking through the telescope (tile 0x59). Daytime (6 <= hour <= 17): 'the sun!', the active member (if none, g_active_member = g_dx after find_first_conscious_member() == 0) takes damage_party_member(1) and the status window is redrawn. Night: g_view_dirty = 1, all 11 rows of g_view_tiles (stride 0x20, 11 bytes each) are set to 0xff, the centre cell 0xac47 to 0x59, draw_map_view(); 80 random stars in g_ui_color2+8 at (y rand 9..0xac, x rand 9..0xb6); then for each of 8 planets p: start index = 0x3750[p]; while the current date (year%100, month, day) is after 5 April of year ..39 (0x27), step the date back one day (day 0 -> 28 and month-1, month 0 -> 13 and year-1) and step the orbit index back to the previous position whose byte in the 22-entry visibility row 0x3760[p*22 + i] is non-zero (index wraps 0 -> 21). draw_sky_planet(row 0x3758[p], index+1); if any g_shadowlord_loc[k] == p+1, draw_sky_crescent(row, index). Finally 'the night sky! ' and wait for a key (poll_key_with_cursor).

0x3750.name: g_planet_start_index
0x3750.meaning: orbit index of each planet on 5 April (year ..39): 12 02 08 0f 0b 06 04 02

0x3760.name: g_planet_orbit_visible
0x3760.meaning: per planet, which of the 22 orbit columns it may occupy (1 = valid)

0x5876.name: g_dx
0x5876.meaning: reused by find_first_conscious_member for the member index

notes: The date loop is O(days since 139-04-05); kept as in the original.

name: look_terrain
proto: void look_terrain(uint tile, int x, int y)  /* Ghidra: (y, x, tile) */
purpose: Describes terrain tile `tile` at map (y, x). Big-object parts 0xe0/0xe1/0xe2 (upper/left/right part markers) move the lookup up / right / left (get_map_tile) until a base tile is found. Then 0x59 -> look_telescope; 0xa1 -> look_well(party z, y, x); (tile & 0xfc) == 0xd8 -> look_fountain; else print_look_description(tile) followed by: clocks (tile & 0xfe) == 0xfa print ' h:mm AM./PM.' (print_number(' ',1,hour%12 or 12), ':', print_number('0',2,minute)); 0xde prints 'Truth' in the Lycaeum (0x1e), 'Love' in Empath Abbey (0x1f), 'Courage' in Serpent's Hold (0x20), nothing elsewhere; 0xdf (dungeon entrance sign) prints the dungeon name chosen by x: 0x7e Wrong, 0x3a Shame, 0x48 Destard, 0x5b Despise, 0x80 Doom, 0x9c Covetous, 0xef Hythloth, 0xf0 Deceit; any other tile just terminates the line with '\n' if the cursor is not in column 0.
notes: Ghidra split the dungeon-name arms into fragments a878..a934 (one listed as 1000:a8d8).

name: fn_1000_a8d8
purpose: Not a function: the 'Deceit' arm (x == 0xf0) of look_terrain's dungeon-sign switch (MOV AX,0x732e; JMP a878). Ghidra listed it because ENDGAME has a real function at the same address (vector 1778:04ca).
notes: Kept as a documented no-op in Rust.

name: print_object_description
purpose: Prints the LOOK2.DAT text of object tile 0x100+tile: file offset of the u16 = tile*2 + 0x200 (built with CONCAT11((tile*2)>>8 + 2, tile*2)), then 0x80 bytes of text at that offset; afterwards a '\n' if the cursor is not in column 0.

name: print_sign_text
purpose:
Prints a sign. offset == -1: the default 'LIVE BY THE EIGHT LAWS' box (strings 0x742a and 0x745e, runic font 1). Otherwise offset is the index of a sign header in g_ool_buffer: text starts at +4; while the first text byte is '
' skip 6 bytes (a '
'-only sign plus the next header). For each byte b: select_font(bit7 clear ? 1 : 0); 0x26/0x27 -> put_char(0x6c); 0x29..0x31 -> font 1 and the box-drawing row string pointed to by 0x37be[b]; 0x0d -> font 0 and read_command_key() (page break); else put_char(b & 0x7f). Stops when the next byte is NUL; font 0; '
' if cursor not in column 0.

0x37be.name: g_sign_row_ptrs
0x37be.meaning: indexed 0x29..0x31: pointers to the 16-char box rows 0x7388.. (g..g, jlllnlllk, ...)

notes: Characters with bit 7 set are plain-font text; clear = runes.

name: look_sign
proto: void look_sign(char z, char x, char y)  /* Ghidra: (y, x, z) */
purpose: Reads the sign at (x, y, floor z). Special case Yew (location 4), z 0, x 0x11, y 0x15: the wanted poster composed from strings 0x7492.. and the first three party names (if i < g_party_count) centred with set_cursor_pos(row, 7-len/2), 'Dead or Alive'. Otherwise loads the 33 u16 offsets of signs.dat, takes the one for g_location, fills g_ool_buffer with 2000 bytes of 0xff, and (offset 0 -> print_sign_text(-1)) loads 2000 bytes of the sign group there, then scans: header bytes +1/+2/+3 == z/x/y -> print_sign_text(index) and stop; else skip the 4-byte header and the NUL-terminated text; if the next header's first byte is 0xff (end) print_sign_text(-1) and stop.
notes: The 2000-byte reads overrun the 0x200-byte OOL buffer into 0xb9ee (RAM only).

name: cmd_look
purpose:
Vector 1778:07a6; ROOT dispatch_command 'L' outside dungeons. get_direction() (0 cancels); target = party x/y + g_dx/g_dy; tile = *get_map_tile; obj = find_object_at(z, y, x). Mirror (tile 0x29): select_target_member (-1 cancels); if rand_range(0x1e,1) >= member intelligence (0x55b6 + m*0x20): 'Death vision!', damage_party_member(1, m), draw_status_window; else 'Strange vision!' and view_gem_map(party y, party x). Otherwise '
Thou dost see
'; obj != 0 -> print_object_description(obj); sign tiles 0x89, 0x8a, 0xa0, 0xa4, 0xf8 -> '
' and look_sign(y, x, party z); else look_terrain(y, x, tile).

name: set_gem_cell_origin
proto: void set_gem_cell_origin(int col, int row)  /* Ghidra: (row, col) */
purpose: g_dx = col*4 + 0x20, g_dy = row*4 + 0x20: the top-left pixel of a 4x4 gem-map cell (the map square spans 0x20..0x9f).

name: gem_draw_speckles
purpose: Gem cell class 1 (grass): pixels (y+0,x+1), (y+2,x+1), (y+1,x+3), (y+3,x+3) in g_ui_color3+8.

name: gem_fill_color3
purpose: Gem cell class 2: fill_rect of the 4x4 cell in g_ui_color3+8. The 56 bytes adb8..adef after it are an unreferenced fragment.

name: gem_draw_top_bottom
purpose: Gem cell class 4: horizontal g_ui_color1 lines on rows y and y+3 (x..x+3).

name: gem_draw_centre
purpose: Gem cell class 5: the inner 2x2 block (rows y+1,y+2; columns x+1..x+2) in g_ui_color1.

name: gem_draw_frame
purpose: Gem cell class 6: a g_ui_color1 frame: rows y and y+3 full, columns x and x+3 on rows y+1..y+2.

name: gem_draw_sun_checker
purpose: Gem cell class 8: 2x2 blocks top-left and bottom-right in g_ui_color_sun.

name: gem_draw_stripes
purpose: Gem cell class 9: rows y and y+2 full plus pixels (y+1,x+2) and (y+3,x) in g_ui_color3+8.

name: gem_draw_water
purpose: Gem cell class 10 (water): four pixels (y,x+1), (y+1,x+3), (y+2,x+1), (y+3,x+3) coloured per bit 8/4/2/1 of 0x3822[tile & 0xf]: tiles 0x60-0x6f with the bit clear use g_ui_color3+8; otherwise g_ui_color4 on CGA/Hercules (g_adapter_type 0/3) or g_ui_color2+8. Implemented with a 4-word stack array walked by three pointers.

0x3822.name: g_gem_water_nibbles
0x3822.meaning: 05 06 04 01 03 06 05 07 07 0e 00 00 01 02 08 04: pixel bit masks for tiles x0..xf

name: gem_draw_deep_dots
purpose: Gem cell class 11: pixels (y,x) and (y+2,x+2) in g_ui_color4 (adapter 0/3) or g_ui_color2+8.

name: gem_draw_mixed_dots
purpose: Gem cell class 13: (y,x+1), (y+1,x+3) in g_ui_color3+8 then (y+2,x), (y+3,x+2) in the deep colour (g_ui_color4 / g_ui_color2+8).

name: gem_draw_building
purpose: Gem cell class 16 (tiles 0x22-0x28): gem_draw_speckles, inner 2x2 in g_ui_color0, then for bits 8/4/2/1 of 0x3812[tile] a 2-pixel edge on the top/right/bottom/left side; tiles 0x22..0x25 get a black doorway pixel at (y+2,x+1)/(y+1,x+1)/(y+1,x+2)/(y+2,x+2).

0x3812.name: g_gem_building_edges
0x3812.meaning: indexed by tile 0x22..0x28 (overlapping the tail of 0x37be and 0x3822): edge bits

name: draw_gem_cell
proto: void draw_gem_cell(uint tile, int col, int row)  /* Ghidra: (row, col, tile) */
purpose: Paints one gem-map cell: class = g_tile_class_1d1a[tile]; set_gem_cell_origin(row, col); switch class: 1 speckles, 2 colour3 fill, 3 g_ui_color0 fill, 4 top/bottom, 5 centre, 6 frame, 7 and 0x5a g_ui_color1 fill, 8 sun checker, 9 stripes, 10 water(tile), 11 deep dots, 12 single deep pixel at (y+2,x+2), 13 mixed dots, 14 vertical g_ui_color1 lines at x+1 and x+2, 15 g_ui_color2+8 fill, 16 building(tile); 0 and others nothing. Returns junk (AX of the last call) which no caller uses.

0x1d1a.name: g_tile_class_1d1a
0x1d1a.meaning: gem-map drawing class per terrain tile

name: view_gem_map
proto: void view_gem_map(char x, char y)  /* Ghidra: (y, x) */
purpose: Vector 1778:078e (ROOT 'V'iew a gem, CAST cd3a/d15e, cmd_look's strange vision). x -= g_chunk_x, y -= g_chunk_y; page 1: black fill_rect(8..0xb7), then draw_gem_cell(row, col, *get_map_tile(g_chunk_y+row, g_chunk_x+col)) for 32x32 cells; copy_rect_between_pages(0xb7,0xb7,8,8, dst 0, src 1); page 0; set_gem_cell_origin(y, x); loop poll_key_with_cursor until non-zero, every 4th poll fill_rect_xor of the party cell in g_ui_color1 (blink); refresh_map_view().
